what: Addendum to 00957: blaze_item_hash::presentation(db, def) covers only a body own names and positions. A function symbol and debuginfo also spell other items: callee paths, the paths of types in a generic instance (mangling), impl self types, debuginfo type names. Key each by the presentation of every item it names (the instance item and its generic arguments items), so renaming a type or a callee re-emits exactly the symbols and debug records that spell it, never stale names, and a fresh build stays byte-identical. From item-hash-store anon2 note.
